guide.description: Two lines of maths, repeated millions of times, drawn as silk. The four knobs are the four letters in the formula.

controls.action: The four knobs are a, b, c and d in the formula. Turn one and the whole figure bends; let go and it sharpens as the points gather.

sections.title: The picture
sections.text: Each formula takes a point and gives the next one. The App follows many points at once and counts where they land: the more often a place is hit, the brighter it is. While a knob turns the figure is a little grainy; at rest the points gather to several million and the picture becomes smooth, then stops. Some settings collapse to a few points, which the device screen says; K2 always leads back to a preset. A large output shows the figure only, with no text.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: The formula, a, b, c and d, the colours, drift and whether the text shows save automatically. A shared link opens the same figure.
